_comment: 상시 등록형 플랫폼(전문가 네트워크·AI 전문가·국내 프리랜서). URL 은 공식 홈페이지. 보수는 공개되지 않았으면 비워 둡니다(=COMPENSATION NOT DISCLOSED). 추정 요율은 config/profile.toml [rates] 에서 ESTIMATE 로만 사용됩니다.

items.title: GLG Network Member – paid expert consultations (healthcare / life sciences)
items.description: Expert network: paid phone consultations, surveys and advisory for investors and companies. Healthcare, diagnostics, life sciences experts. Remote, per-call hourly compensation.

items.title: Guidepoint Advisor – paid expert consultations
items.description: Expert network: remote paid consultations for investment and corporate clients; healthcare and life sciences advisors. Hourly compensation per consultation.

items.title: AlphaSights Expert – paid expert calls
items.description: Expert network connecting investors and consultants with industry experts for remote paid calls. Hourly compensation.

items.title: Third Bridge Specialist – expert interviews and forums
items.description: Expert network: paid remote interviews, forums and research calls with specialists including healthcare and diagnostics.

items.title: Coleman Research Expert – paid consultations
items.description: Expert network: paid remote consultations with healthcare and life sciences experts. Hourly compensation.

items.title: NewtonX Expert – B2B expert consultations and surveys
items.description: Expert network: paid remote consultations and surveys for B2B research, including healthcare and biotech.

items.title: Mercor – domain expert roles for AI model training and evaluation
items.description: Platform matching domain experts (medicine, biology, PhD researchers) to hourly contract work training and evaluating AI models. Remote, asynchronous, AI interview.

items.title: DataAnnotation – expert AI training (science / professional track)
items.description: Remote asynchronous AI training work: writing and evaluating AI responses; qualification assessment instead of live interview. Hourly pay.

items.title: micro1 – expert contractor for AI training data (medical / science)
items.description: Platform recruiting domain experts as remote contractors for AI training data and evaluation; AI interviewer screening. Hourly contract.

items.title: Outlier – expert AI trainer (biology / medicine / PhD)
items.description: Remote asynchronous AI training for subject experts; skills assessment onboarding; hourly pay.

items.title: AfterQuery – expert contributor for AI research datasets
items.description: Recruits domain experts to create and review high-quality datasets for frontier AI labs. Remote contract work.

items.title: LILT – expert linguist / domain reviewer (Korean–English, life sciences)
items.description: AI-powered translation company working with freelance linguists and domain reviewers; Korean-English life sciences content review. Remote.

items.title: OpenTrain AI – freelance AI training expert marketplace
items.description: Freelance marketplace for AI training data experts; set own rate; remote project work.

items.title: Multicampus Expert Hub – 전문강사 상시 등록 (기업교육)
items.description: 삼성 계열 기업교육 회사의 전문강사 풀 상시 등록. 바이오·헬스케어, 의료 AI, 보고서 작성, 리더십 강의. 강사료 비공개.

items.title: 크몽 – 논문 진단·학술 편집·연구 컨설팅 서비스 판매
items.description: 국내 프리랜서 마켓. 학위논문 정밀진단, 학술 원고 편집, 통계 해석, 연구 설계 자문 상품 판매. 원격, 건당 결제.

items.title: 숨고 – 논문 컨설팅·통계·강의 견적 요청 대응
items.description: 국내 고수 매칭 플랫폼. 논문 컨설팅, 통계 분석, 의생명 과외·강의 요청에 견적 발송. 견적 발송 비용 발생 가능.

items.title: 탤런트뱅크 – 전문가 프로젝트 매칭 (자문·교육)
items.description: 국내 전문가 프로젝트 매칭 플랫폼. 기업 자문·교육 프로젝트 단위 계약.
